RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; these facts do not support a defensible numerical estimate.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications are strong, but a head-level role may also prioritize leadership, regulatory expertise, and interview performance. The announcement does not establish her full qualifications.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and the reasons for the decision. Keep correspondence.

Raise concerns about sex discrimination if specific evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or inconsistent application of criteria—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you might challenge the decision, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
